findings.asset_text: Palbociclib is metabolized primarily by CYP3A and the sulfotransferase SULT2A1, and it is itself a weak time-dependent inhibitor of CYP3A. In formal interaction studies, the strong CYP3A inhibitor itraconazole increased palbociclib AUCinf and Cmax by approximately 87% and 34%, respectively, while the strong CYP3A inducer rifampin decreased palbociclib AUCinf and Cmax by approximately 85% and 70%.
